git.note: NO SHAs ARE RECORDED HERE ON PURPOSE. The previous version pinned develop=5f75fcd main=66c0873 and both were stale within the hour, because the commit that wrote them moved develop past them. Present-tense git claims are comparisons; run the verify commands.
git.working_tree: clean apart from the untracked type-level/ orphan from another session
verify: test "$(git rev-parse develop)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/develop)"   # develop is pushed
test "$(git rev-parse main)"    = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)"      # main is pushed

git merge-base --is-ancestor develop main   # everything on develop is in main. NOT the reverse: main carries a --no-ff merge commit per release, so --is-ancestor main develop is false on a healthy repo.
test -z "$(git diff main develop)"          # identical trees -- this is the real equivalence check

decisions.rationale: 0.44/0.45 dropped the .js emit: 1287/1288 tsc errors. Rewriting all 396 files was MEASURED on a throwaway snapshot and still left 288 errors, because the shipped .d.mts files import the core vocabulary and never re-export it. Every mechanical fix is a cast, an any, or a redeclared type -- all forbidden. The literal requirement (take 0.43.0) is satisfied.

decisions.rationale: from_ocr was imported by nothing and ocr_amount only by it; PDF/OCR extraction in code is permanently out of scope and the vision pass emits both forms directly. The vnd.fjs.ocr DIALECT stays registered.

decisions.decision: The engine reaches guest programs via guestCtx, never a server tool
decisions.rationale: A finance_compute_1040 tool would let the agent stop authoring programs. tools/list has stayed at 13 through twelve phases; that count is the check.

decisions.decision: An asserted fact whose absence must not read as 'no' is two exact strings, not option(true)
decisions.rationale: option(true) makes absence indistinguishable from a denial, and for SSTB and the EIC facts the wrong default is the one that GRANTS money.

context_notes: Two failures in this session are worth more than the features. FIRST: `git push` reported success while doing nothing, three times, because an agent run un-isolated in the main checkout left HEAD on its own branch -- caught only because main's TEST COUNT came back 2185 instead of 2242, not by checking a ref. SECOND: the proof suite had been running TWICE for months, recorded as a 'double-counted metric, severity advisory, remedy: de-duplicate'; it was double-RUN, ~53s per invocation, and the documented workaround is exactly why nobody looked again. A workaround that works is the most expensive kind of bug. The through-line across eleven occurrences this session: only a COMPARISON stops a count from drifting -- naming the hazard in a comment failed three separate times, while the two gates added (theHandTypedListNamesEveryModeledKind, dialect_parity) each caught a real omission within a day.
